title: One of my malls is inside giant trees
content: I visit this mall infrequently, but often enough for it to be a familiar and wonderful treat. It's your standard mall, with shop fronts and a food court, and even a play area for the smaller kids, but it's all inside the trunks of three or four gigantic trees. You get from one tree to the next by way of a series of bridges made from the branches, or, if it's your fancy, some of those cable car/gondolas. I love shopping and exploring here. It's a little crowded, but never slammed, and everything is built in such a way to naturally blend and integrate into the wood.
